title: Read row validity through ordinary entity properties
goal: Read SQL Server temporal history using database-generated CLR period properties, without treating those boundaries as user-editable dates.

selectionNotes: SQL Server temporal columns are generated by the database and cannot be updated by users. EF10 uses shadow period properties; EF11 can map them to CLR properties with private setters. Private setters express intent; SQL Server enforces the write restriction.
